g.text: CX70M-24P1 electrical interface; shell/ESD integration open

g.desc: CX70M-24P1 electrical interface; shell/ESD integration open

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: MCU/RF NOT CAPTURED; proposed signals NO GPIO numbering

g.desc: MCU/RF NOT CAPTURED; proposed signals NO GPIO numbering

g.text: Cap latch: PRE_N=!(VBUS_OK & AON_OK); CLR_N=AON_OK & (CAP_OK | VBUS_OK); RUN=Q & AON_OK.

g.desc: Cap latch: PRE_N=!(VBUS_OK & AON_OK); CLR_N=AON_OK & (CAP_OK | VBUS_OK); RUN=Q & AON_OK.

g.text: 15F at2.6V /25mA charge; runtime must subtract 100mV charge hysteresis. Stable source/PG still cannot promise future commit energy.

g.desc: 15F at2.6V /25mA charge; runtime must subtract 100mV charge hysteresis. Stable source/PG still cannot promise future commit energy.

g.text: MCU/RF and existing ISOW1412 sheet are explicit boundaries; no resident RDM loader, security/update code or PCB routing claimed.

g.desc: MCU/RF and existing ISOW1412 sheet are explicit boundaries; no resident RDM loader, security/update code or PCB routing claimed.

g.text: SERVICE is distinct from ROM strap; MCU pin allocation lives in mcu-radio/. Power boundary numbers are not package pins.

g.desc: SERVICE is distinct from ROM strap; MCU pin allocation lives in mcu-radio/. Power boundary numbers are not package pins.

g.text: MODE=AON_RAW independent of RUN. U19 low-loss reverse barrier; U10 senses actual NORMAL_IN (no slow input RC).

g.desc: MODE=AON_RAW independent of RUN. U19 low-loss reverse barrier; U10 senses actual NORMAL_IN (no slow input RC).

g.text: CURRENT POWER-ONLY DESIGN: USB data pins NC. <=500mA PSD design basis; COLD START NOT ACCEPTED (ISS max unknown).

g.desc: CURRENT POWER-ONLY DESIGN: USB data pins NC. <=500mA PSD design basis; COLD START NOT ACCEPTED (ISS max unknown).
